ranked.headline: Pipelines and benchmarks address error in bacterial, viral, and lineage genome inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair automated long-read pipelines with controlled benchmarks and error correction for pandemic-scale and metagenomic data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of metabolite identity and conjugates from tandem mass spectra
ranked.summary: Large public MS/MS repositories and learned spectral models now support structure proposal and cross-polarity spectral comparison at scale.

ranked.headline: Coarse and language-conditioned representations cut reliance on full atomic structure
ranked.summary: Open-source structure predictors now report gains over AlphaFold 3, while coarse-representation scorers target binding affinity at lower computational cost.

ranked.headline: Deep models map regulatory sequence and chromatin context to expression readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple DNA sequence and chromatin context with generative objectives for single-cell perturbation and expression prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map trans-eQTLs, mosaic repeats and methylation QTLs at scale
ranked.summary: Single-cell and population-scale datasets now let variant detection resolve trans effects, somatic repeat mutations, and regulatory QTLs.

ranked.headline: Language models tune tokenization and decoding for protein and genomic sequence tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications evaluate sequence-model design choices against structure, fitness and interaction outcomes.

ranked.headline: Learned and mechanistic models guide primer, enzyme, and in vitro transcription design
ranked.summary: Computational models now predict primer designs, enzyme turnover, and transcription yield before wet-lab testing.

ranked.headline: Csr/Rsm protein binding is conserved across gamma-proteobacteria while regulons diverge
ranked.summary: Comparative inference now links conserved RNA-binding protein architecture to lineage-specific regulon divergence across bacterial taxa.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in biological knowledge for single-cell and perturbation analysis
ranked.summary: LLM agents are now benchmarked on scRNA-seq, perturbation, and rare disease tasks, testing how external knowledge improves biological inference.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict promoter activity and forecast single-cell state transitions
ranked.summary: Sequence-trained and generative models now target regulatory readouts and long-range single-cell trajectories, moving beyond static prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned rescoring and automated workflows reshape DIA and cross-linking proteomics
ranked.summary: Analysis choices in DIA and cross-linking mass spectrometry now determine which evidence is recovered, prompting learned and workflow-level solutions.

ranked.headline: Generative and mechanistic evolution models tested on protein and genomic sequence data
ranked.summary: Large genome collections and multi-scheme simulations now let explicit evolutionary models be tested against empirical sequence and population data.

ranked.headline: Harmonized omics metadata resources enable queryable, portable access to public datasets
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous public omics annotations are being harmonized into queryable, portable resources, with four new preprints reporting such tools.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict splicing, ribosome sites and miRNA targets from RNA sequence
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 preprints apply transformer and convolutional models to splicing, ribosome positioning and miRNA targeting from sequence.

ranked.headline: Inferring connectivity and gene-regulatory dynamics from simulated and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study recover network structure and state transitions from neural and gene-expression measurements.

ranked.headline: Statistical and simulation tools for expression analysis across bulk and spatial data
ranked.summary: Recent papers and preprints refine power analysis, meta-analysis and differential testing for RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Explicit structure in shared latents and priors for incomplete multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Incomplete and unpaired omics data are increasingly modeled with explicit structural constraints built into the learning framework.

ranked.headline: Interpretable and multimodal models link histology, transcriptomes, and molecular states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair whole-slide images, transcriptomes, and mutation profiles with concept- or prototype-based representations that support interpretation.

ranked.headline: Language model layers and scale shape alignment with human language-network fMRI
ranked.summary: Training dynamics, model compression, and narrative context length each alter how well LLM representations predict human fMRI responses.

ranked.headline: Web, cloud and CLI tools packaging simulation, docking and molecular design workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers describe packaged web, cloud and command-line tools making simulation and AI-driven molecular design more accessible.

ranked.headline: Kinetic and hybrid models resolve metabolic and regulatory dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models increasingly link enzyme localization, growth coupling, and nutrient fluxes to experimentally testable predictions.

ranked.headline: Natural-language interfaces layered over omics and gene-regulatory data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM guidance and web platforms with omics, gene ontology, and literature-derived regulatory data for interactive exploration.

ranked.headline: Computational models resolve cell states from single-cell, spatial, and imaging data
ranked.summary: High-dimensional per-cell measurements beyond mRNA counts are now being paired with computational models to interpret cell states and tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics resolve regulatory control and cell lineage in tissues
ranked.summary: Atlas-scale single-cell and spatial datasets now support inferring regulatory networks, enhancer hubs, and somatic lineages directly from measured cells.

ranked.headline: Molecular simulations map flux and fusion pathways in condensates and lipid membranes
ranked.summary: Residue-level and enhanced-sampling simulations now probe non-equilibrium flux, LNP endosomal escape, and field-driven membrane fusion at molecular resolution.

ranked.headline: Generative AI models now design antibodies, nanocages, de novo proteins and RNA aptamers
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 items apply generative and language-model methods to antibody, protein, and RNA engineering tasks.

ranked.headline: Learned representations for cryo-EM particle classification and RNA motif modeling
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 items add a large RNA motif density benchmark and feature-based methods for cryo-EM particle classification and curation.

ranked.headline: Evaluation leakage and weak validation inflate predictive performance claims in biology
ranked.summary: Audits show leakage in 23 of 32 published drug response methods, making rigorous splitting and inference checks timely.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneity in susceptibility, environment and transmission shapes epidemic dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints encode stress, temperature-driven infection loss and individual transmission variance as explicit, analyzable model components.

ranked.headline: Simulations map proton-coupled transport and PET hydrolysis mechanisms
ranked.summary: Adaptive MD, Markov state modeling, and QM/MM umbrella sampling now resolve transport and hydrolysis energetics at atomic detail.

ranked.headline: Structure-Aware Constraints on Learned Representations in Medical Imaging
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie model design to imaging or tissue structure, spanning MRI embeddings, expansion microscopy, and synthetic pre-training.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate reproducible genomic and chromatin data analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM frameworks now translate analytical intent into validated, executable workflows, with documentation quality also under automated assessment.

ranked.headline: Feature-based computational prediction of centromeres, chromatin, and DNA motifs
ranked.summary: Long-read and pangenome assemblies now enable de novo prediction of centromeres and accessible chromatin, alongside motif database reduction.

ranked.headline: Geometric and statistical frameworks for redox, orbital, and phase-separation data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply tropical geometry, orbital energy statistics, and confound-controlled benchmarking to biomolecular data.

ranked.headline: Network Algorithms Predict Rare Disease Genes and Metabolic Gene Function
ranked.summary: Genome-scale prioritization tools now target rare disease diagnosis, causal regulator inference, and metabolic gene discovery in parallel.

ranked.headline: MRI connectivity moves from descriptive mapping toward predictive and causal inference
ranked.summary: Resting-state fMRI and diffusion MRI resources are now used for predictive and causal modeling of clinical and behavioral variables.

ranked.headline: Profile-based tools unify RNA virus discovery, taxonomy and domain annotation
ranked.summary: Pipelines now package viral contig detection, ICTV taxonomy and Pfam annotation into end-to-end workflows rather than separate steps.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide data reveal lineage-specific evolutionary change in turtles, dogs and humans
ranked.summary: Genome-wide sequence data now resolve evolutionary history and selection in non-model and under-sampled populations.

ranked.headline: Graph representations of genetic variation scale across ARG, genotyping, and simulation
ranked.summary: Stable ARG infrastructure and throughput-focused genotyping and simulation tools now target biobank-scale and pangenome datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational tools extract structural features from coevolution, dynamics, tomography
ranked.summary: Three new open tools map coevolving residues, residue dynamics and tomographic particles into interpretable spatial and dynamic descriptors.
